title: PaperMeta
description: papers/<id>/meta.json. The full published record for one paper.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

hook_turn.description: The closing clause of the hook, set in the second voice (the light italic). Must be an exact suffix of hook. Written by whoever writes the hook, never guessed from position. Absent means the whole hook is set in the first voice.

readout.description: The one number the card shows large, taken from the paper.

value.description: The numeral as printed, for example 0.96, 42, >5.1. With exponent set, this is the mantissa.

exponent.description: Power of ten. value 1.0 with exponent -21 prints as 1.0 times ten to the minus 21.

unit.description: Unit in words or symbols, for example angstroms. Absent for a pure number.

label.description: What the number measures, for example: Peak strain. Pitch 35 to 250 Hz.

depth.description: What the page was built from: "full" for a full explainer (the paper's full text, by the expert, visualizer, and checker), "abstract" for a quick explainer (the title and abstract, by one agent). page.depth in the render check's check.json. null for a paper without a page. Absent on papers published before quick explainers, which are all full explainers.

made_by.description: The model ids that made the page. For a full explainer: the expert, visualizer, and checker. For a quick explainer: the one quick agent. Present only on papers whose run recorded them.

check.description: The render check's check.json (render, which for a quick explainer carries the numbers check in page.numbers) and the checker's review.json (review; null for a quick explainer, which has no checker).
